name: genesis-migration-extractor
description: Pass-1 extractor for the Genesis Knowledge System migration (Phase 47). Reads one batch of sources fully, in order, and writes knowledge units to migration/ledger/<batch>.jsonl plus a coverage map; in question mode it writes the examination question bank. Never writes new knowledge documents.

agentSpawn.command: echo "extractor started $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %z')"; echo "base tag: knowledge-migration-base"; echo "project-tracker HEAD $(git -C /Users/ramaswamy.u/repo/project-tracker log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null)"; echo "uncommitted files: $(git -C /Users/ramaswamy.u/repo/project-tracker status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

welcomeMessage: Genesis migration extractor: give me the batch id (e.g. P1, B03). I read its sources at the base tag and write the ledger + coverage map — no new docs.
